title: DANAHER CORP /DE/ 8-K Filing — 2026-04-29
summary: Danaher Corporation filed an 8-K on April 29, 2026 announcing the issuance of €3 billion in aggregate principal amount of senior notes across four tranches: €500 million floating rate notes due 2028, €750 million 3.250% notes due 2030, €750 million 3.625% notes due 2034, and €1 billion 4.000% notes due 2038. The issuance was conducted pursuant to a registration statement on Form S-3 and a preliminary prospectus supplement.
key_points: Danaher issued €500 million Floating Rate Senior Notes due April 29, 2028, with quarterly interest payments beginning July 29, 2026
Danaher issued €750 million 3.250% Senior Notes due April 29, 2030, with annual interest payments commencing April 29, 2027
Danaher issued €750 million 3.625% Senior Notes due April 29, 2034, with annual interest payments commencing April 29, 2027
Danaher issued €1 billion 4.000% Senior Notes due April 29, 2038, with annual interest payments commencing April 29, 2027
The notes were issued under a base indenture dated December 11, 2007 and a sixth supplemental indenture dated April 29, 2026
The offering was made pursuant to Registration Statement on Form S-3 (File No. 333-278426)
why_it_matters: This is a corporate debt issuance by Danaher Corporation, a healthcare and industrial conglomerate. The filing does not address market structure or macro catalysts and is therefore not relevant to the archive's focus topics.
